profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at Keysight Technologies
profile.summary: An accomplished Information Technology professional with over twenty years of experience in the development and delivery of integrated software solutions, including architecting, programming, and implementing complex applications using a variety of platforms, technologies, and tools. Meticulous and adaptable learner known for creative problem solving, mentoring others, sharing knowledge, excellent communication and listening skills, and the ability to easily translate business concepts into technical paradigms. Extensive experience with Retail, Supply Chain, Pharmaceutical, Manufacturing and Distribution systems.
